description: This Java class 'SurveyValidator' serves as a validation component within the 'org.apache.fineract.spm.domain' package. It validates 'Survey' objects by checking various fields such as key, name, country code, description, and questions, ensuring they meet specified constraints. It throws a validation exception if any errors are detected.

classes.name: SurveyValidator
classes.description: A Spring component responsible for validating Survey objects before processing or persistence.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Public method that performs validation on a Survey object, accumulating errors and throwing exception if any validation issues are found.

methods.name: validateQuestions
methods.description: Validates the list of questions within the survey, ensuring each question meets required constraints.

methods.name: validateOptions
methods.description: Validates the responses/options for a question, ensuring responses are present and within constraints.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Checks if validation errors exist and throws a PlatformApiDataValidationException if so.
